paragraphs: I love exploring. Whether I’m at my desk or traveling to a new country, I’m always curious to learn new perspectives. With experience across banking, technology, and entrepreneurship, I enjoy implementing my interdisciplinary skills in unique situations. I’m driven not by my accomplishments, but rather by my intense desire to grow through challenges.
Away from the desk, I’m usually exploring new hobbies, golfing, or traveling somewhere new with a camera in hand.
